<observations>
Date: Jul 15, 2026
* 🔴 (08:15) User stated they have a torn meniscus in the left knee and sleep 7 hours every night.
* 🔴 (12:45) User works as a graphic designer at an agency downtown; owns a Garmin Forerunner 265 (resting HR 52 bpm) and Nike Pegasus shoes (45 miles).
* 🟡 (14:00) Agent discussed beetroot juice, logged baseline metrics, and generated eccentric calf raises.
* ✅ (20:05) Training check-in reminder scheduled for the next morning.

Date: Jul 18, 2026
* 🔴 (09:00) User prefers coconut water, takes evening magnesium, works from home Thursdays/Fridays, and has a golden retriever.
* 🟡 (17:20) Agent reviewed cadence data, anti-chafing balms, dynamic warm-ups, and adjusted weekly mileage goal to 28 miles.
* ✅ (20:30) Weekly training schedule summary updated in active memory.

Date: Jul 21, 2026
* 🔴 (13:15) User has been a vegetarian for over 4 years; prefers outdoor running and Merino wool socks.
* 🟡 (14:45) Agent provided shoe care tips, logged a foam roller purchase reminder, and reviewed contrast water therapy.
* ✅ (17:00) Daily recovery log updated with today's observations.

Date: Jul 24, 2026
* 🔴 (12:10) User stated their half marathon is on September 4, 2026; refuses to run with headphones on busy streets; prefers black coffee before long runs and whole-wheat pasta before hard workouts.
* 🟡 (14:45) Agent added insulated water bottles to shopping list, analyzed sweat sodium loss, and reviewed swimming cross-training.
* ✅ (17:00) Weekly training schedule updated.

Date: Jul 28, 2026
* 🔴 (08:45) User prefers high-density foam rollers, refuses bouncing waist packs, and eats steel-cut oats with blueberries on high-mileage mornings.
* 🟡 (14:45) Agent added high-density foam rollers to shopping list, reviewed compression socks and stationary cycling.
* ✅ (17:00) Weekly recovery schedule updated.

Date: Aug 1, 2026
* 🔴 (08:45) User strongly dislikes static stretching before morning track sessions and refuses neon apparel on early road runs.
* 🔴 (18:20) User stated they have never had a cardiac stress test.
* 🟡 (14:00) User plans to buy a replacement dark moisture-wicking running cap at the downtown shop tomorrow.
* ✅ (17:00) Monthly training log updated with cross-training and nutrition notes.
</observations>
